task.summary: Original reused storage3 CSharp and Native, original optimization and jobs profiles

selectionReason: Reuse original3 exact vectors from character and enum qualifications. Their CSharp optimization flag is omitted and Native defaults to O1; jobs omitted on both. Execute original profiles using existing generic verifier before Native; current source and oracle bytes unchanged.

import sys;from pathlib import Path;sys.path.insert(0,'scripts');from verification_focused_proof import read,sha,generic_proof;from verification_stdlib_source_preflight import validate;import completed_artifact_plan as a;root=Path.cwd();b=root/'artifacts/scratch/resume-20261113/junction-arity521/envelope553/candidate554';out=b/'storage-extra620';c=read(out/'contract.json');i=read(out/'intake.json');assert c['cases']==read(Path(i['originalContract']))['cases'];assert 'harnessBuildOptimization' not in c and 'harnessBuildJobs' not in c;assert validate(root,b/'stdlib527/result.json')['status']=='passed'
